text: The new fee structure also results from fund managers foregoing market rate management fees, larger investors requiring reduced management fees as a condition of investing, and side-by-side co-investment vehicles charging less than 2% management fees.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Applications and Fee Structure Developments in Private Investment Funds (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2959730
